title: 法国预算僵局：市场波动反成推手，妥协真能逼出来吗
speaker: Emmanuel Cau

segments.en: Good morning and thanks for having me. Look, I think we see the global equity market has become a stage of the rate and the oil volatility.
segments.zh: 早上好，谢谢邀请。我认为全球权益市场已经成为利率和油价波动的舞台。

segments.en: And I think the stress in rates is a bit more acute in Europe. And I think with regard to the French situation, which is very much where the attention is, look, I think it's going to be tricky for the next couple of weeks at least.
segments.zh: 我认为欧洲的利率压力更为严重。关于法国局势，这是当前关注的焦点，我认为至少未来几周会非常棘手。

segments.en: I mean, it's going to take a couple of weeks for the parliament in France to discuss the budget. And as always, you know, into the presidential elections, there's going to be a lot of noise and a lot of opposition to this budget, which is coming up with a significant amount of fiscal tightening.
segments.zh: 法国议会需要几周时间讨论预算。而且和往常一样，在总统选举前，会有很多噪音和反对声音，这个预算伴随着显著的财政紧缩。

segments.en: But look, ultimately, I think we've been there before and I think, to some extent, the market stress might facilitate the adoption of the budget. So the market is going to job and it might be forcing politicians to agree on the budget, ultimately.
segments.zh: 但最终，我认为我们以前经历过这种情况，某种程度上，市场压力可能促进预算的通过。所以市场会发挥作用，可能最终迫使政客们就预算达成一致。

segments.en: But look, this is going to be a bumpy ride to get there and the past, towards fiscal and political stability, it's still very tricky in my view.
segments.zh: 但通往财政和政治稳定的道路将是颠簸的，在我看来仍然非常棘手。

segments.en: So we've been cautious on the French market and the French domestic stocks in particular. You know, tactically, you can say maybe the risk is getting better because a lot of things have come down now.
segments.zh: 因此我们对法国市场和法国本土股票一直持谨慎态度。从战术上看，可以说风险正在改善，因为很多因素已经回落。

segments.en: Spreads are the widest, you've had in almost 15 years, but look, we think the fundamental picture is still calling for caution here.
segments.zh: 利差处于近15年来最宽水平，但我们认为基本面仍然需要保持谨慎。
